Role: Associate Consultant
Industry: Market Research
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: Easy to use, intuitive interface, initial setup is easy and integration is also possible like Gmail. Good tool to manage your sales pipeline and very handy in running email campaigns.
Cons: Customer support is not up to the mark. They always respond very late. Its reporting system is also not that effective.
Comments: It is a decent CRM, helpful in managing your sales team and tracking the sales process, but there is room for improvement.
Switched from: SumUp|Whova|Notion|UpKeep

Role: SDR
Industry: Computer & Network Security
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 3
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: It is a great first CRM when you are a small company just starting your business and growing your database. I started using it in my previous role in a very small startup and it did the job for a while, the knowledge base management is great and quite intuitive. Would definitely recommend for a small budget and small startup.
Cons: Some of the features were very tricky, the layout is not very intuitive and it is quite hard to see all your information. Once again, if you try to scale or actually do forecast/sales pipeline review, I'm not sure it is the best tool
Alternatives considered: HubSpot CRM

Role: Co-owner
Industry: Retail
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: An awesome hybrid for team email and sales funnel management supercharged with marketing automation features.
Cons: The ability to write email through the app.

Role: Entrepreneur
Industry: Machinery
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I made first experience with SAGE CRM and Salesforce before I started with Freshsales. Implementation was very easy. I use it every day to follow up on sales leads and I send out a newsletter every month. But the best thing about Freshales is the support by Chat. You get immediate responses and help so that can get the job done. In most other CRM solutions there is either no support or it takes forever to respond.
Cons: nothing really, Sometimes I miss functionality that is only available at higher costs by purchasing more expensive plans
Comments: Fantastic product

Role: Operations Executive
Industry: Information Technology and Services
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Categorization of leads to analyze the funnel. Note all the followups with brief details. To coordinate with others using ownership.
Cons: Visualization can be better More number of filters make it complex sometimes

Role: Head of CSM
Industry: Accounting
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Clean design, easy to use, and customisable with lots of useful features for daily sales management.
Cons: Very expensive for what it offers. Requires too many add-ons (e.g., add-ons for the number of emails, contacts, api connections), and support could be much better.
Comments: Good overall experience. It works well and looks great, but the pricing and support let it down. Support is particularly bad, a lack of understanding of their product.
Reasons for switching: So that it would integrate with our other Fresh tools.
Switched from: HubSpot CRM

Role: CEO and Founder
Industry: Paper & Forest Products
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: There are number of pros but I will highlight couple of them. 1) Even the free version of the CRM is quite impressive and fully packaged to handle an organization's CRM requirement. 2) The team pushes the update on regular basis and the updates are quite thoughtful 3) Email configuration 4) Custom url for your organization 5) Unlimited agents even in the free version 6) Tasks & Appointments is what I like the most
Cons: Proposal/Quotation and Invoicing is not there currently. but, I am sure the team will have it in their bucket list.
Comments: We have been using Freshales for over an year now and our experience has been quite superb. I really appreciate their thoughtful updates on regular intervals.

Role: CEO
Industry: Marketing and Advertising
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: I used a free trial
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: It's very easy to use this awesome CRM software.
Cons: Sorry, i found nothing , everything is fine :-)

Role: Key Account Manager
Industry: Food & Beverages
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: No waste of time, just the core of what you really need.
Cons: nothing for the moment, has what I need and can't find any defect

Role: Founder & CEO
Industry: Consumer Services
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: The interface is very well organized, easy to navigate and use.
Cons: I wish Freshsales had a gmail plugin to offer email tracking outside of the platform.
Comments: Freshsales keeps our startup organized and productive. We set tasks in Freshsales to remind our team members of important objectives. Freshsales is a great hub for our sales team to build our database of leads and customers. Being able to oversee communication between our team members and prospects makes it easy to track relationships.

Role: Cloud Architect
Industry: Computer Software
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I found the reporting and analytics to be very insightful, and I was able to use them to improve my sales performance.
Cons: I found the price to be a bit high for some businesses and mobile app to be lacking in features compared to the desktop version

Role: Associate
Industry: Computer Software
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 3
Pros: The user experience is quite amazing and doesn't need someone with any training since it’s self-explanatory in most cases. The integrations we have used so far have been easier to implement and have been terrific for our performance increasing the efficiency of our team quantifiably. The 14 day free trial period is quite helpful, unlike HubSpot or Freshworks which offer access to limit features under the free tier plan.
Cons: The major con here would be that as we scale, the ability of Pipedrive to suit our needs might reduce drastically. Better suited for smaller teams & businesses.
Comments: One of the solutions where the tool is worth the price!
Switched from: Aircall|Marketo Engage

Role: Head of Customer Success
Industry: Marketing and Advertising
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 3
Pros: Pipedrive's simplicity, customization options, and visual pipeline management are some of the aspects that I personally appreciate, however the 'deal' section should be better designed
Cons: There should be more options for the customisation of 'deals' as well as 'reports' sections. Mobile app should give opportunity to see files
Comments: We are solving the problem of managing the list of our clients and history of cooperation with them. Nevertheless it would be great to see more customisation options in pipe drive, specially if it comes to the deals management section. For instance notes can't be moved od filtered, they are 'static' .

Role: e-commerce manager
Industry: Retail
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Mobile app is very practical and helps me a lot in business management.
Cons: It could have more integrations,I was not able to download it.
Comments: Great, basic and practical package.

Role: Team Lead Enterprise
Industry: Human Resources
Company size: 201-500 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I like the ease of use. Its makes it an intuitive tool for sales teams.
Cons: Sometimes you can have 2 same contacts and you have to merge it by yourselve , if you have a big contact base it could be a hard work
Comments: Very good experience for me as a manager to follow the kpi of m'y sales team and very easy to onboard new fte on this product

Role: Sr. Director of Business Development
Industry: Internet
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: You understand all uses within about 10 minutes of this product which is a huge plus. It is simple to find the BCC to pipedrive function so you can easily have emails sent out to clients and prospects appear in the system.
Cons: Definitely cumbersome to input items into the system in an easy fashion. Feels more seamless on other systems.
Comments: My experience is so so. It does the job it is supposed to do at a basic level.

Role: Consultante RGPD
Industry: Insurance
Company size: 5,001-10,000 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 3
Ease-of-use rating: 3
Pros: Création de campagne marketing très facileGestion de contact.Intégration avec d'autres CRM
Cons: Coût du produit élevéQuelques bug pour l'automatisation de campagne

Role: Finance
Industry: Leisure, Travel & Tourism
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: The layout and design setup. It displays our deals and messages in a smart style.
Cons: Sometimes the settings messes with the integration of other systems we use.
Comments: So far it’s ideal for tracking sales and their current status.

Role: Head of business development
Industry: Design
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Nice interface and user experience. Very good on third party apps integrations
Cons: The app isnt so good, but i use it. Some improvements would be great on ios app. The performance isnt so good. sometimes it lags a lot
Comments: its a great crm
Reasons for switching: insightly is a poor crm
Switched from: Insightly

Role: Manager
Industry: Information Technology and Services
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Simples de usar, intuitivo e sobretudo muito clean.A forma como as coisas estão dispostas é muito boa.
Cons: Não me recordo de nada em particular, sinceramente.
